notes:
桌面 TUN 换成批量系统调用，同一节点上更快。

## 优化

- macOS 的 TUN 数据面改用批量系统调用（`recvmsgx` / `sendmsgx`）。此前对虚拟网卡
  是逐包一次系统调用，现在一次最多搬 59 个包，同一节点上吞吐更高、CPU 更低。
- Linux 的 TUN 打开 GSO，内核可以整块交付分片卸载的超帧，同样省掉逐包的系统调用。
- 桌面的 geosite 匹配改用最小完美哈希，DNS 分流查表更快（移动端维持原有的省内存实现）。

三项都只改系统调用与查表的形状，不改路由、DNS 语义或协议行为。Windows 与手机端
的数据面不变。

## 韧性

- 万一 TUN 加速在某台机器上起不来，客户端会自动不带加速重试一次并记下来，
  30 天后再试一次，不需要手动处理。

## 兼容性

账号、订阅和节点协议兼容现有服务。更新签名公钥与平台安装身份保持一致。
Flutter 3.47.2、Dart 3.13.2、Go 1.26.8 和 Mihomo v1.19.30 稳定基线不变。
notesEn:
Desktop TUN now moves packets in batched syscalls — faster on the same node.

## Improvements

- The macOS TUN data path switches to batched syscalls (`recvmsgx` / `sendmsgx`).
  It used to issue one syscall per packet on the virtual interface; it now moves up
  to 59 packets per syscall, which raises throughput and lowers CPU on the same node.
- The Linux TUN enables GSO, so the kernel can hand over segmentation-offloaded
  super-frames in one piece instead of one MTU-sized packet per syscall.
- Desktop geosite matching switches to a minimal perfect hash, making DNS policy
  lookups faster. Mobile keeps the memory-frugal implementation.

All three only change the shape of syscalls and table lookups — routing, DNS
semantics and protocol behaviour are untouched. The Windows and mobile data paths
are unchanged.

## Resilience

- If the TUN acceleration cannot start on a given machine, the client retries the
  same start once without it and remembers that, then tries again 30 days later.
  Nothing to do by hand.

## Compatibility

Accounts, subscriptions and the node protocol remain compatible with the current
service. The update signing key and the per-platform install identity are unchanged.
The Flutter 3.47.2 / Dart 3.13.2 / Go 1.26.8 / Mihomo v1.19.30 baseline is unchanged.
